sections.title: Sound of the letter a
paragraphs: The letter is named (a) /a/. Its main sound is a vowel, which is a sound made with open air and no touch in the mouth. You hear it in the word (amore) /aˈmo.re/, which means love. This letter has only one sound in Italian.

sections.title: How to say the letter a
paragraphs: To say this vowel, drop your jaw low. Keep your tongue flat and low in the bottom of your mouth. Do not push your tongue forward or back. Leave your lips relaxed and wide open. Your voice is voiced, so your throat vibrates. Put your fingers on your throat to feel the strong vibration.

sections.title: Spelling rules for the letter a
paragraphs: This letter always makes the same sound in all positions. In every syllable, it sounds like the vowel in (amore) /aˈmo.re/. It never changes near other letters or at the end of a word, as heard in (casa) /ˈka.za/.

sections.title: Mistakes to avoid with the letter a
paragraphs: Do not turn this vowel into a schwa, which is a weak sound like the first vowel in about. Do not let unstressed vowels become weak. Do not say it like the flat vowel in cat. Keep your mouth wide open and say a clear, bright sound every time.
